questions.question: A man writing to the Philippians hoped to send Timothy to visit them. What did he say this would do for him?

answers.text: He would be cheered to learn how they were doing
He would get help preparing for his trial
He would get supplies for his time in chains

questions.question: How did the man writing to the Philippians say Timothy had served with him to advance the gospel?

answers.text: Like a child with his father
Like a soldier with his captain
Like a servant with his master

questions.question: Epaphroditus, a fellow worker of the man writing to the Philippians, longed for his friends in Philippi. Why was he distressed?

answers.text: The Philippians had heard he was ill
He had not heard from Philippi
The letter's writer might soon be sentenced

questions.question: The man writing to the Philippians told them to welcome Epaphroditus with great joy. What did he say Epaphroditus nearly died for?

answers.text: For the freedom of the letter's writer
